item.title: Shorter Clip Same Opening

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen video of a paper boat drifting slowly across a pond, fixed camera, soft morning light. Silent, no text.
Shorter—5 seconds. Just cut off the end, don't speed it up or change anything else.

item.tests: Tests whether shortening trims the existing clip to its first five seconds without regeneration, speed changes or a second generation charge.

answer_sheet.Which section to retain: Keep the first five seconds of the existing eight-second clip; remove only the final three seconds.
answer_sheet.Playback speed and transitions: Keep the original playback speed. Do not add fades or transitions.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Natural-looking pond scene in soft morning light; other details are your call.

must_haves: The final video lasts five seconds.
Its opening frame and subsequent footage match the first five seconds of the original clip.
The paper boat moves at the original speed, with no retiming or reordered footage.
The ending is a simple cut, with no added fade or replacement shot.
The video remains 16:9, silent and free of text.
